Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game then! It is Bangladesh who take the lead and they now have a chance to seal the series with a win in the next which is a must-win for the hosts. That game will be played on the 20th of March and it will begin at 1330 IST (0800 GMT). Join us for the build-up though which will begin earlier. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Tamim Iqbal, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that it is a big win for them, a special win as they have never won in South Africa. Tells that Das and his partnership was good. He adds that Yasir Ali innings was special and overall everyone contributed. He applauds his fast bowlers and says that they have been doing quite well recenty. He adds that one needs the character like Mehidy in the team and adds that he bowled brilliantly under pressure. Tells that Mehidy Hasan was his man of the match. Mentions that they can celebrate today and they need to focus tomorrow and South Africa is a good side and recokns that they will come hard at them. He mentions that they need to come prepared in the next game.

Shakib Al Hasan is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that when he spend 7-8 balls, he thought that it is a good wicket and they needed over 300. He says that they wanted to capitaise on the good start and keep the monetunm going and applauds Yasir Ali for his performance. He mentions that as soon as shine was gone the ball did not do much and they had to take calculated risk and it came off today. Tells that it was important to go in the middle overs and the momentum they gained in the 30-40 th over proved vital. He mentions that they knew Rabada would bowl in the end and their scoring rate meant that he had to be brought in early.

Temba Bavuma, the skipper of South Africa says that Bangladesh had momentum coming into the break as they have away 180 runs in the last 20 overs. He says that they need to have lot of conversations about their performance with the ball and they did well in the start but could not do well in the last overs. He says that they would have been happy with 270-280 on the board but they gave away 40 runs more and and that was the difference in the end. Tells that with a big score to chase they needed someone to play a big innings and score the century and says that his dismissal was untimely. He mention that they need to play better in the next game and have to bounce back. States that they need to show resilience they are known for.
Time for the presentation...

Bangladesh were brilliant with the ball! It was Taskin Ahmed and Shoriful Islam with the new ball who caused problems. The Fizz, Mustafizur Rahman and Shakib Al Hasan continued the good work in the middle overs. They did not pick wickets but kept a hold on the scoring. Mehidy Hasan leaked runs in his initial overs but came back strongly at the death. The pick however, were the Taskin Ahmed and Shoriful Islam who were just brilliant and always took wickets when needed. Overall, a very clinical show by the visitors.

In the chase, they lost three early wickets. Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen then steadied the ship but when it was time to up the ante, Bavuma fell. Miller and Rassie van der Dussen then revived the hopes but the former fell when his side needed him to go on for longer. It was all left for Miller to do in the end, he tried his best but it was too much of a task and in the end, his side fell well short.

To be honest, that stand between Yasir Ali and Shakib Al Hasan just took the game away from them. The rate at which they scored with was outstanding and since then, South Africa just could not find a way back into the game.

A thumping win for Bangladesh to take a 1-0 lead in this series. What a statement made by them, they were not given a chance by many to win probably even one game but they have beaten the hosts in the first one itself and in some style.

OUT! LBW! That's it! Bangladesh have created history! It is their first ODI win on the South African soil. They have won this game comfortably. A flatter delivery on middle. Keshav Maharaj goes for a revsere hit but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. The umpire turns it down. Mahmudullah asks his skipper to take the review and Bangladesh take it. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat involved. The Ball tracker rolls and it shows three reds. So Keshav Maharaj is gone and South Africa have been bowled out. Bangladesh win by 38 runs!
Dropped! Short delivery on middle. Ngidi pulls it to deep mid-wicket and it goes straight into the hands of the fielder there. He drops it and a single is taken.
SIX! Another biggie from Ngidi! This is fuller and on middle. Ngidi launches it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
WIDE! This is down the leg side. Ngidi looks to work it towards the leg side but misses.
Shorter delivery on middle. Keshav Maharaj goes back and pushes it to long on for a single.
SIX! Poor delivery and punished by Keshav Maharaj! A shorter delivery on middle. Keshav Maharaj pulls it high and handsome over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Flatter delivery on off. Ngidi pushes it towards the off side. 54 needed now from 12 balls.
SIX! A half-tracker on middle. Ngidi goes back and pulls it to deep square leg for a biggie. Good shot from the number 11.
A fuller delivery on off. Keshav Maharaj slogs it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery, outside off. Keshav Maharaj goes for a reverse-slog but misses.
FOUR! So Keshav Maharaj is adding some runs to his kitty. A fullish delivery on off. Keshav Maharaj heaves it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
A slightly shorter delivery, around off. Keshav Maharaj looks to pull but misses.
Back of a length, on off. Ngidi blocks it out. 65 needed now from 18 balls.
In the air...but safe! On a length, on off. Ngidi makes room and hit this aerially towards deep extra-cover. The ball falls in the vacant region and couple of runs are taken.
A fuller delivery on off. Ngidi drives it to covers now.
On middle and fuller. Keshav Maharaj scoops it towards third man for a single.

FOUR! Lucky for Keshav Maharaj! This is full on leg. Keshav Maharaj makes room and looks to hit it away. The ball catches the outside edge of his blade and goes towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, on middle. Keshav Maharaj works it to short fine leg.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off. Keshav Maharaj goes chasing for it but misses.
A flatter delivery on off. Ngidi blocks it out.
Tossed up on middle. Lungi Ngidi tucks it towards the leg side.
A flatter delivery on middle. Ngidi works it towards the leg side.
Lungi Ngidi is the last man in.

OUT! STUMPED! This will seal the deal for Bangladesh! It has been a great second spell from Mehidy Hasan. He bags his fourth wicket now. It pitches around off and turns away from Miller. Miller is well down the pitch as he looks to hit it towards the off side. He misses. Mushfiqur Rahim collects the ball and whips the bails in flash. Miller is out of his crease and with this South Africa's last hope of pulling off a victory is gone.
Commentary.Howout: st Mushfiqur Rahim b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide outside off. Keshav Maharaj cuts it aerailly towards point for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and wide outside off. Keshav Maharaj goes deep in his crease and cuts it through extra-cover for a boundary.
Now a single is taken off the last ball! 78 needed from 30 balls! Back of a length, outside off.  Keshav Maharaj upper cuts it to third man for a single.
Another dot ball! Back of a length on off from 'round the wicket. Keshav Maharaj dances down the track and goes for a wild swing across the line but misses.
Angled into the body. Keshav Maharaj only manages to defend it towards the off side.
Back of a length, outside off. Keshav Maharaj throws his bat at it but misses.
On a length, around off. Miller dabs it to point and takes a single.
FOUR! Boundary for Miller and he is still fighting it out there. A full delivery on leg. Miller flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Keshav Maharaj is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another one goes down and more pressure buidling on Miller now. This is short on middle. Rabada looks to pull it but the ball turns away and catches the top edge of his blade. The ball goes high in the air back to the bowler. Hasan goes slightly behind and completes the catch with ease in the end.
Short and wide outside off. Miller cuts it through point for a single.
Tossed up delivery on off. Rabada hits this hard to long on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant presence of mind shown by Tamim Iqbal! A fuller delivery on middle. Jansen goes for a big slog-sweep. He connects it pretty well but fails to get the elevation. Tamim Iqbal at deep mid-wicket takes the catch but realises that the momentum is taking him over the ropes. He throws back the ball in the playing area and then comes back inside to complete the catch. Another wicket and Bangladesh in control now. Kagiso Rabada is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Tamim Iqbal b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! That has missed everything and bonus runs for South Africa. This pitches on leg and turns into the batter. It keeps low and Jansen misses the pull. The ball goes past the leg stump and races away for a boundary.
Hasan lands this on off and it turns away. Miller cuts it to covers for a single.

Shoriful Islam does well in the latter half of the over. Still though, 17 from it. Till the time Miller is out there, the hosts are still in it. 91 needed in 42, we have seen such scores being chased before. A fuller one outside off, it is hit through covers for one.
Carved away! Just the one though! Shorter and on off, this is hit down to third man for one.
Just the one! Miller probably feels he has got the amount of runs he needs in an over, gently pushes this fuller ball down to long off for one.

FOUR MORE! 14 from the first three balls now! This could well be the momentum shifting over! Poor delivery, it is on the pads, Miller says thank you very much and just clips it past the diving short leg fielder. Still three more balls to go. Miller is pumped up.
FOUR! 10 from the first two! Shoriful Islam is not fully fit and he is going the distance here. A slower one on off, Miller shuffles across and drags it through mid-wicket. Boundary.
SIX! Bang! That is out of here! A lot more of these needed! This is right in Miller's arc. Full and on middle, this is heaved over the long on fence for a biggie. Need to make this a huge over now.
And again, nice and slow, on off, Miller only takes one as he pushes it to covers. Run rate needed above 13 now. 108 needed in 48.
Beautiful bowling! Slower and on off, gets it to turn away. Miller pushes it to covers.
Jansen goes after it straight away! On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

NOT OUT! Miller is in and there was no edge on it too! This is tossed up outside off, Miller looks to go over covers but this lands and turns away. He misses. Rahim is quick in taking the bails off. It is referred but replays show Miller is well in.
Is this stumped? The replays roll in and they show that Miller's back leg is inside the crease. So Miller will continue.
Marco Jansen is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Andile Phehlukwayo's struggle comes to an end! He just had to go after it even if it costs him his wicket. Steps out, does not get to the pitch of it but still looks to clear long off. He ends up slicing it down into the throat of the fielder there. Liton Das takes a fine catch. Quite a poor innings from Andile. He did no good for his team there.
Commentary.Howout: c Liton Das b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: A dot which means Andile will remain on strike! Slower and just outside off, Miller looks to push at it but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Just a single off his bat now! On off, shorter, this is pushed through covers for one.

Andile Phehlukwayo just can't keep dotting up now! He needs to go, all of this is increasing the pressure on Miller! Shorter and outside off, this one zips through. Andile Phehlukwayo looks to cut but is beaten.

Really good fielding again! Bangladesh have been outstanding in the field! Fuller and on off, this is dragged towards deep mid-wicket, it is more off the toe-end. Das runs to his left and keeps it down to one.
WIDE! This is well wide outside off, left alone by Miller.
Andile Phehlukwayo finally gets off the mark! On middle, slower, it is worked towards short fine leg for one.

Fifty for Miller! Another superb knock from him. He is well and truly capable of taking his side over the line but needs a little support. Gets there by strokig this wide delivery through covers for one.
Just the single from the over then! On middle, fuller, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Yet another dot! This is not good from the all-rounder. Shorter and outside off, he slashes but misses.
He is 0 of 7 now. Pressure building. Slower and outside off, Andile Phehlukwayo looks to go over covers but misses.
Make that 6! Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover. The fielder there dives to his left and half stops it. No run.
5h dot for Andile Phehlukwayo, he needs to get going now! On off, this is kept out.
Singles won't be much of a help! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Good length and on off, defended. 117 needed in 11 overs now. This has to be Miller time. We have seen him do this before can he play another special knock here?
Misfield and an easy single! On off, fuller, this is hit towards cover. The batters go for one. The fielder misfields and a run is taken.
FOUR! Timed wonderfully! Fuller and on off, Miller leans forward and creams it past mid off for a welcome boundary. They need a few more of these.
Extras will help but boundaries is what they need! Down the leg side. Miller looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Three dots in a row now! Outside off yet again, slower in pace! Miller slashes at it but misses.
Yet another dot! Shorter and outside off, Miller slaps it to covers.
Angled into middle, this is kept out.
On middle, this is pushed to covers.
Andile Phehlukwayo has been hit on his helmet. We will have mandatory concussion test now. He looks fine and is ready to resume.

Right on the helmet! That has hit Andile Phehlukwayo! It was a really quick delivery. Short and on the body. Andile Phehlukwayo looks to pull but is beaten by pace. He gets hit on the helmet. He actually got a top edge onto the helmet.
Another sharp bumper on middle, Andile Phehlukwayo evades it.
Bangladesh now have their tails up! Another very good stop! On off, this is guided towards point, the fielder dives to his right and makes a good stop. Only one.
A good short one and on middle, Miller mistimes the pull to mid-wicket.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Taskin Ahmed has got the big fish! Rassie walks back 14 short of a ton and Bangladesh will now feel they well and truly have this game in their bag. What a catch that was from Yasir Ali. A catch of high pressure and he has hung on brilliantly! On middle, Rassie van der Dussen heaves it towards deep square leg. It is not right off the middle, more off the inner half. Ali in the deep, runs to his right, dives and takes it brilliantly. Miller more or less has to do it alone now. A special catch to end a special innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Yasir Ali b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Taskin Ahmed is back to bowl his last over. He has given away 35 runs so far in 9 overs and has taken two wickets.
This is quicker and flatter on middle. Rassie van der Dussen goes deep in his crease and pushes it to long on for a single. 124 runs needed from 78 balls!
Goes fuller on off. Miller drives it to long off for a single.
A flatter delivery and quicker on off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to mid off for a single.
This is fuller on off. Miller drives it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Miller with another powerful hit! This is short and around off. Miller goes back and creates a bit of more room and crunches it through covers for a boundary.
Quicker on middle and shorter. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Mahmudullah is into the attack now.
FOUR! Miller is getting in the mood today! Short and wide outside off. Miller cuts it hard through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! BANG! Shorter and flatter on off. Miller skips down the track and hammers it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Goes shorter on middle. Rassie van der Dussen goes back and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the shorter side again, on off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to covers.
Ohhh...almost dragged on! Slower in the air, outside off and it stays low. Rassie van der Dussen looks to cut but gets the inside edge onto the turf.
Pushed quicker on leg. Miller skips down the track and works it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, around off. Miller guides it to backward point for a single. 143 needed from 90 balls.
Back of a length, around off. Miller mistimes his cut shot to covers.
Lands this on a length, around off. Miller cuts it towards deep backward point for a couple.
On a length, around off. Miller hits it hard to mid off.
FOUR! Clever from Miller! Back of a length, around off. Miller late-cuts it over the slip fielder for a boundary.

A length delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen hits it hard to mid off andd takes a single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but Rassie van der Dussen is inside his crease. The leg umpire though goes upstairs to confirm it and replays confirm that he is safe.
Flatter and quicker on off. Miller punches it to the cover fielder in the ring. Bangladesh were 161-3 at the same stage.
Shorter delivery, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it left of long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to mid on.
A flatter delivery on middle and leg. Miller works it to square leg for a single.
Shorter around off. Rassie van der Dussen goes back and pushes it to long off for a single.
Darted around off. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it to backward square leg.
A slower length delivery, outside off at 117 kph. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to deep cover for a single. Just 3 runs from the over.
Back of a length, on off. Miller opens the face of his blade and guides it to third man for a single.
Another delivery on that tight line, a length delivery on off. Miller blocks it out.
Good-length delivery on off. Miller defends it towards point.
On the shorter side, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to point.
A flatter delivery on middle and slightly shorter in length. Miller knocks it back to the bowler.
Tossed up nicely on middle. Rassie van der Dussen heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Miller pushes it to long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower in the air, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen gets across and looks to sweep but misses.
Darted on leg. Miller works it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over and 13 runs from it. A fuller delivery on middle. Rassie van der Dussen sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Slower in the air, around leg. Rassie van der Dussen makes room and looks to work it towards the leg side but the ball hits his pads.
A flatter delivery and slightly shorter on off. Miller cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Ohh...Miller with a 96 metres hit! A fuller delivery on middle. Miller gets under it and launches it over long on for a biggie. Clean strike!
On middle this time. Rassie van der Dussen sweeps it aerially but short of Shakib Al Hasan at deep square leg for a single.
A flatter delivery, outside off. Miller cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks!  Bangladesh are still ahead in this game. The partnership between Bavuma and Rassie van der Dussen was pretty good for South Africa but Banagldesh have managed to break it. Now with 174 needed from 20 overs, South Africa need Rassie van der Dussen and Miller to carry on and take this game deep. While Bangladesh would hope to break this partnership soon rather than latter and it will help them dominate the proceedings further.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Miller works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
SIX! Miller with a lovely shot over long off. This is fuller on off. Miller gets under it and launches it over long off for a maximum.
Slightly shorter on off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Miller pushes it to long on for a single.
Slightly shorter outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter delivery around off. Rassie van der Dussen skips down the track and gets the leading edge just short of the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan (6-0-27-0) is back on.
Another dot to end! On off, this is pushed to covers. 184 needed in 21 overs. The two will now have to treat this like a T20 game.
This time gets hold of the pull and hits it throgh square leg. Only for one.

WIDE! That was a loud, loud appeal from the bowler! A short one down the leg side. Rassie looks to pull but misses. The umpire waits to see if the team is taking the review, they do not and it is wided.
Off the outer half! Fuller and on off, Miller looks to push at it, it goes off the outside edge past point for one.
Good change in length! A bumper and outside off, left alone.
Good length and on off, Miller guides it to point.
WIDE! Short and well wide outside off, Miller slashes but misses.
Outside off, Rassie pushes it through covers and takes one.
Another run! Run rate needed now above 8.5. On off, this is pushed through covers for one. 189 needed in 132.
Back of a length and on off, blocked.
Singles really won't trouble the visitors! On off, this is pushed on the up to mid off for one.
Another one on a length and around off, defended.

Edged but short! That would have been game over had it gone to hand. length and on off, Rassie looks to defend but this goes off the outside edge, lands short of Rahim who dives to his right and gets a hand to it. Just the single as it goes down to third man.
Good length and angling into the middle pole, blocked by Rassie.
A single to end the over, another terrific one for Bangladesh! Short and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
OUCH! That might have hurt! Short and on the body, Rassie looks to pull but misses. He gets hit near the rib area.
Angled into the pads, this is worked fine down the leg side for one and Muller is off the mark.
David Miller is the next man in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! The move to get Shoriful Islam on has worked. He has broken the stand which was worrying Bangladesh. However, the wicket of Bavuma could well be a blessing in disguise for the hosts as he was really struggling to score at the pace they needed to go. This is short and on middle, Bavuma looks to play the upper cut but it goes off the edge and to Rahim. Bangladesh continue to hold a firm grip on the game. 194 more needed. .
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Bavuma needs to start hitting the gaps! Fuller and on off, Bavuma shows the full face of the bat and strokes it to covers.
Another dot for Bavuma! On off, he looks to drop and run towards point but is sent back.
Shoriful Islam (5-0-23-1) is back on.
That is a superb over! Much-needed, the last two overs went for runs and Taskin bowls an over which only goes for one. Lovely. On off, this is pushed to covers.
Yet another dot! Good stuff from Taskin! On middle, this is pushed to the right of the bowler who dives and stops it.
Angled into middle, Rassie hangs back and defends. Dots will build pressure.
Slower one and on off, Rassie pushes it to covers.
Just the one! Angled into middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Bavuma really needs to step on the gas now! He is only looking to get Rassie on strike! On off, Bavuma looks to push it on the off side and take one but is sent back.
Another single to end another good over for South Africa! The two need to keep going. On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Good placement again! Two taken! On middle, this is worked wide of long on for two.
FOUR! That is sheer timing and wonderful placement! On middle, this is whipped hard through square leg, it is in the gap and into the fence.
Just the one! Bavuma too needs to find the fence now! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
On a good length outside off. Bavuma looks to push it away but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
WIDE! Bouncer on off. Bavuma ducks under it and the umpire calls it wide for height.

Appeal from the bowler and other players from Bangladesh but it is too optimistic. Back of a length, around off. Bavuma is cramped for room and he tries to make it and guide this towards third man. The ball flicks the pad first and then hits his bat as it it goes towards the off side. Tamim Iqbal decides to not take a review and good call from the the skipper.
Back of a length, around off. Bit of extra bounce and Rassie van der Dussen gets hit on the glove as he guide it towards third man for a single.

SIX! Fifty for Rassie van der Dussen! A bit of luck there but everything before has been class from Rassie van der Dussen. This one is short on middle. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it but gets a top edge. The ball sails over the fine leg fence for a maximum.
Ahmed serves this short and wide, a cutter this time. Bavuma mistimes his cut to covers for a single.
Bangs this one short on off. Rassie van der Dussen pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
100 up for South Africa! Slightly shorter on middle and leg. Rassie van der Dussen turns it left of short fine leg for a single.
Slower in the air, around off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes this back to the bowler off the inside half of his blade.
On middle and turning into Bavuma. He turns it towards deep square leg for a single.
A half-tracker on off. Bavuma pulls hard but straight to mid-wicket.
Slower in the air, on middle. Bavuma works it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery on middle. Bavuma pushes this off the inside half of his blade towards backward square leg and gets a couple. Good running!
On a length, on middle at 140 kph. Rassie van der Dussen works it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off. Bavuma rides the bounce and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it uppishly and it goes off the bounce towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen dabs it to backward point.
FOUR! Rassie van der Dussen is getting into his groove now! This is not that full, on a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it to covers.
Single to end the over and 11 runs from it. Tossed up on off. Rassie van der Dussen eases it down to long on for a single.
Slower in the air on middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it towards the leg side.
Pitches this on off and it turns into the batter. Bavuma works it with the turn towards square leg for a single.
On middle and fuller. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to long on for a single.
FOUR! So the pressure on the offie straightaway! 50 partnership comes up. On off and fuller. Rassie van der Dussen reverse-sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Mehidy Hasan is greeted with a boundary! Slightly on the shorter side on off. Rassie van der Dussen punches it through covers for a lovely boundary.
Mehidy Hasan is into attack now.

Dot to end the over. This has been a good tidy spell from the left-hander. Lands it on a length, on off. No room for Bavuma to work with. He defends it towards the off side and looks for a single but is sent back by his partner.
Angling into middle. Rassie van der Dussen works it to fine leg for a single.
Ohh..cutter this time! On a length, outside off at 117 kph. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend but the ball grips and it turns away to beat the outside edge of his blade.
Lands it on a length, outside off. Bavuma punches it to deep cover for a single.
On a length, outside off at 138 kph. Rassie van der Dussen drives it on up and the ball catches the outside edge of his blade. It goes towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Bavuma works it to deep square leg for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Bavuma turns it to long on for a single.
Fuller again, on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to deep cover for a single.
Slower in the air and fuller on off. Rassie van der Dussen knocks it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side again, on off. Rassie van der Dussen goes deep in his crease and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Goes slightly shorter on off. Bavuma rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to long off for a single.
Just a run from the over! On a length, around off. Bavuma punches it to point. The fielder fires a direct hit at the batter's end but Bavuma is well inside his crease.
Lands it on a length, around off. Bavuma punches it to covers and looks for a single. He is sent back by his partner.

Gets the single now! On a good length and a trademark slower delivery at 117 kph. Rassie van der Dussen gets surprised by the bounce and pace of the ball and ends up guiding to third man for a single.
Slightly fuller on off. Rassie van der Dussen knocks it back to the bowler.
Hits the length hard again, on off. Rassie van der Dussen goes back and blocks it.
Rahman goes 'round the wicket and lands it on a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it towards the off side.
Just the single to end! Only 5 from the over then. On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
So, the boundary has been followed by 4 dots. On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and on the stumps, kept out.
On middle, defended.
This lands on off and then turns away. Rassie looks to push but is beaten.
FOUR! Finds the gap nicely! A low full toss, this is clipped away through mid-wicket for a boundary. Welcome one, can they make this over count now?
On off, this is guided through point for one more.
From around the wicket now, this is on a length, it is guided down to third man for one.
Slower one on middle, Rassie works it fine on the leg side for one.
Well fielded! On off, Rassie guides it towards point. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it.
Fuller and on off, Bavuma pushes it to mid off and takes one.
Shorter and outsid eoff, Bavuma looks to cut but misses.

Drinks! Bangladesh have backed up their good batting performance with some quality bowling in these first 15 overs. They have taken three early wickets and South Africa are in all sorts of trouble. A lot depends on this pair in the middle for South Africa. However, Bangladesh have some good variety in their bowling and it looks a tough task for South Africa from hereon. The next phase is crucial and South Africa need it to go their way.
Loopy ball on off, Rassie pushes it to covers.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, this is blocked.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Flatter and on off, Rassie guides it to point.
On middle, defended.
Change of ends for Shakib Al Hasan. He is back into the attack.
BEATEN! So despite the boundary, only 5 from the over. Length and around off, angling away. Bavuma looks to drive but is beaten.
On middle, blocked.
On middle, Rassie works it to mid-wicket.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! Nice and fine! South Africa need more of such freebies! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side and it races away to the fence.
Just giving nothing away at the moment! Length and on off, Rassie defends.
He does close it out well, just the two from it! On middle, this is tucked away through square leg for one.
Yet another dot! Fuller and on off, Rassie strokes it to mid off. Can Taskin now end the over well?
On off, this is pushed to mid on.
That is a beauty! The ball is still moving around. Length and angling into the off pole, it lands and then moves away. Rassie is beaten as he tries to block.
Flashy stroke but only for one! Outside off, this is hit hard through covers for one.
Back of a length and on off, Bavuma blocks it.
A dot to end. 6 from it. On off, defended.
FOUR! That is wonderfully played! Deft! Outside off, Rassie plays the reverse sweep, he plays it very fine on the off side and a boundary results. Just guided it.
Flatter and on off, this is guided to point.
Fuller, this is eased down to long off for one.
Tossed up on off, defended.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on. He has given 8 runs in the two overs he has bowled so far.

Just the two runs then from the over! On middle, Rassie van der Dussen works it through square leg and gets to the other end. Another good over by Taskin. The run rate is now a shade under 7. 271 needed.
This time takes one! Fuller and on off, Bavuma strokes it to mid off and gets to the other end.
Yet another dot! Good length and on off, Bavuma pushes it to mid off.
Shorter in length again and on off, Bavuma pushes it to covers.
Lovely shot but for no runs! Length and on off, Bavuma pushes it off the back foot but to covers.
On middle, this one stays a touch low. It is pushed to mid on.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A length delivery on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it towards the leg side.
Back of a length, on off. Rassie van der Dussen blocks it solidly off the back foot.
Beaten! Islam lands it on a good length on off and angles this across. Rassie van der Dussen looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Lands it on a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen defends it towards the off side.
Bavuma is struggling with his left leg. He seems to have stretched something as he completed that single. Physio is out and Bavuma is getting some treatment now. He is fine now and ready to resume.
Ohh...cheeky little single. A length delivery on off. Bavuma defends it towards the off side and sets off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. A single taken.
WIDE! Lands this on a length but down the leg side at 135 kph. Bavuma looks to clip it but misses.
On a length, around off. Bavuma drives it to point.
FOUR! Nicely played! On a length, around off. Rassie van der Dussen leans forward and just pushes it through covers for a boundary. Good timing.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen leaves it alone.
Rassie van der Dussen is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in the over and South Africa are in huge trouble now! A fullish delivery, outside off. Aiden Markram goes for a big boomimg drive away from his body. The ball slices off the outside edge to point and Mehidy Hasan there takes a sharp catch. Aiden Markram walks back without troubling the scorers and Bangladesh are all over South Africa now.
Commentary.Howout: c Mehidy Hasan b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, on off. Aiden Markram blocks it out.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
Aiden Markram is the next man in.

OUT! LBW! Both the openers are back to the hut now! What a start this has been for Bangladesh. Brilliant stuff from the seamers. Lands this on a length, on off at 140 kph. It nips back in sharply and beats the inside edge of Kyle Verreynne's blade as he looks to defend. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. The umpire raises his finger and it looks dead straight. Kyle Verreynne has a chat with his skipper, Bavuma and decides against taking a review. He walks back and Bangladesh are right on the top.
Back of a length, around off at 140 kph. Bavuma punches it to covers.
Goes fuller on off. Bavuma drives it to mid off.
FOUR! Poor delivery and Bavuma takes full advantage of it. A length delivery on middle. Bavuma clips it fine towards the long leg fence for a boundary.
Lands this on a length, on off and it nips into the batter now. Kyle Verreynne defends this off the inside half of his blade to square leg for a single.
A length delivery on off. Kyle Verreynne pushes it back to the bowler.

Beats the putside edge of his blade again. This is on a good length, it pitches on the off stump line and goes across the batter. Kyle Verreynne looks to drive but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Yes, he does! On a length, around off. Bavuma pushes it towards the off side. Maiden from Taskin Ahmed!
Five dots in a row in this over! A good-length delivery, around off. Bavuma defends it towards point. Can he finish this over with another good delivery?
Hits the length hard again, at 141 kph. Bavuma blocks it back to the bowler.
Serves it on a good length, outside off. Bavuma pushes it towards covers.
On a good length, on off at 141 kph. Bavuma defends it towards the off side.
Back of a length, on middle. Bavuma defends it solidly off the back foot to mid on.
Slightly short of good length, on off. Kyle Verreynne looks to push it towards the off side but gets the inside half of his blade towards the leg side.
Serves it on a length, on middle. Bavuma pushes it right of mid on for a single.
On the shorter side again, on middle. Bavuma rides the bounce and blocks it.

FOUR! Back of a length, around leg. Bavuma goes back and looks to defend. Again good bounce for Islam and the ball kisses the glove of Bavuma. It goes past the keeper who tries to move towards his left and a boundary towards long leg.
Lands this on a length, on middle. Kyle Verreynne works it to fine leg for a single.
Absolute jaffa! A good-length delivery on off and it seams across the batter with some extra bounce. Kyle Verreynne looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Back of a length, on middle at 141 kph. Bavuma works it through mid-wicket for a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
Drifts on the pads now. Kyle Verreynne glances it to fine leg for a single.
A bit shorter around off. Kyle Verreynne looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Goes fuller on off at 140 kph. Kyle Verreynne drives it through cover-point for a boundary. Not off the middle of his blade but enough on this quick outfield.
This one keeps a little low! A good-length delivery, around off. Kyle Verreynne dabs it towards backward point.
Starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off. Kyle Verreynne defends this towards the off side. The ball hits him high on the bat.
Taskin Ahmed is into the attack now.
Lands this on a length, on off. Bavuma defends it towards the leg side.
Temba Bavuma walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Shoriful Islam strikes early and this is a big wicket for Bangladesh! The prolific scorer at the top of the order departs early. This is on a good length and angling across the batter. Malan looks to defend it but the ball catches the outside edge of his blade. Mushfiqur Rahim behind the stumps takes a good low catch. The umpires are not sure about the catch being clean and they take it upstairs. The soft signal is not out. The replays show that the catch is clean and Malan has to walk back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Mushfiqur Rahim b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Goes slightly short on middle. Kyle Verreynne rides the bounce nicely and works it towards fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Kyle Verreynne blocks it out.

SIX! Lucky for Kyle Verreynne! Bangs this one short on middle. Kyle Verreynne looks to pull but the ball catches the outside edge of his blade. It goes in the air and goes over the third man fence for a maximum.
On a length, on middle at 141 kph. Bit of extra bounce and Kyle Verreynne rides the bounce and blocks it.
A flatter and quicker delivery on middle. Malan defends it towards the leg side.
Slower in the air, on off. Kyle Verreynne drives it to long off for a single.
An arm ball this time on middle. Kyle Verreynne makes a bit room and pushes it to covers.
A flatter delivery on middle. Kyle Verreynne works it towards the leg side.
Goes fuller on off. Malan makes room and drives it through covers for a single.
Flatter and on middle, this is defended.
Lands this on a length, on off. Malan pushes it to mid off and takes a quick single.
Back of a length, on middle. Kyle Verreynne works it to fine leg for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Malan pushes it to mid off for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Malan defends this back to the bowler.
On a length, around off. Malan pushes it to cover-point.
Beats him first up! A good-length delivery around off. Enticing Malan to drive. He does but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade.
Shoriful Islam will start from the other end.
A flatter delivery on middle. Kyle Verreynne works it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Overpitched on off. Kyle Verreynne leans forward and creams this one through covers for a boundary.
Goes fuller on off. Malan drives it to long off for a single.
Darted on middle and leg. Kyle Verreynne works it past square leg for a single.
This is pushed outside off. Kyle Verreynne pushes it to covers.
A fuller delivery on middle to start. Kyle Verreynne pushes it to mid on.
